<!-- add-to-cart.fez -->
<script>
  class {
    add() {
      Fez.publish('cart:add', { id: this.props.product_id })
    }
  }
</script>

<button onclick="fez.add()">Add to cart</button>

<!-- cart-count.fez -->
<script>
  class {
    init() {
      this.state.count = 0
      this.subscribe('cart:add', () => {
        this.state.count++
      })
    }
  }
</script>

<span>Cart: {state.count}</span>

<add-to-cart product_id="book-7"></add-to-cart>
<cart-count></cart-count>
